name: browser-testing-with-devtools
tagline_zh: 调试页面时，别靠猜。让代理打开真实Chrome，直接查DOM、抓报错、看网络请求，连性能画像都给你——比肉眼快十倍。
tagline_en: Stop guessing. Your agent drives real Chrome to inspect DOM, capture console errors, trace network, and profile.
desc_en: Tests in real browsers via Chrome DevTools MCP. Use when building or debugging anything that runs in a browser. Use when you need to inspect the DOM, capture console errors, analyze network requests, profile performance, or verify visual output with real runtime data. Requires the chrome-devtools MCP server to be configured.
why_zh: 同类工具多模拟环境，它直接连DevTools协议，拿真实运行时数据，连视觉输出都能验证，调试一步到位。
why_en: Unlike simulators, it taps the real DevTools protocol for live runtime data—even visual checks—so debugging is grounded, not.
